workflow.title: Cisco Intersight - Remove VLAN from VLAN policy

properties.description: Deletes one exact fabric.Vlan from one exact fabric.EthNetworkPolicy. Confirm Removal defaults false and must be true. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read organization/fabric resources and delete fabric.Vlan. It validates VLAN ID 1-4093, protects VLAN 1, resolves exact ownership/cardinality, shows the policy/VLAN Name/ID/Moid summary, and revalidates it before DELETE. OpenAPI documents only HTTP 200 with no content as success: non-200 is failure, missing status is ambiguous, and unexpected 200 content is inconsistent success without retry. A second run handles not-found and issues no DELETE. GET and DELETE are not transactional, so concurrent writers can change state; validate behavior in a non-production tenant. Generic APIs are used until a supported atomic exists.

actions.title: Validate and normalize VLAN removal request

properties.description: Requires Confirm Removal=true, rejects VLAN 1, and emits correlated exact-name OData fields and a preparation token.
properties.display_name: Validate and normalize VLAN removal request
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
preparationStatus = 'helper-failure'
preparationStatusCode = '500'
preparationMessage = 'VLAN removal input preparation did not complete.'
preparationResultJson = json.dumps({'error': preparationMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
preparationToken = ''
normalizedOrganizationName = ''
normalizedPolicyName = ''
escapedOrganizationName = ''
escapedPolicyName = ''
normalizedVlanId = 0
confirmationAccepted = ''
NAME = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}$')
try:
    organizationName = sys.argv[5]
    policyName = sys.argv[6]
    vlanIdText = sys.argv[7]
    confirmText = sys.argv[8]
    errors = []
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[9]))
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[10]))
    try:
        if not re.fullmatch('-?[0-9]+', vlanIdText):
            raise ValueError()
        vlanId = int(vlanIdText)
    except Exception:
        vlanId = 0
        errors.append('VLAN ID must be an integer.')
    if not 1 <= vlanId <= 4093:
        errors.append('VLAN ID must be from 1 through 4093.')
    if vlanId == 1:
        errors.append('VLAN ID 1 is protected and cannot be removed by this workflow.')
    if confirmText in ('true', '1'):
        confirmed = True
    elif confirmText in ('false', '0'):
        confirmed = False
        errors.append('Confirm Removal must be true before any target lookup.')
    else:
        confirmed = False
        errors.append('Confirm Removal must be a boolean value and must be true.')
    if errors:
        preparationStatus = 'invalid'
        preparationStatusCode = '400'
        preparationMessage = ' '.join(errors)
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({'error': 'Input validation failed', 'details': errors}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        normalizedOrganizationName = organizationName
        normalizedPolicyName = policyName
        escapedOrganizationName = sys.argv[11]
        escapedPolicyName = sys.argv[12]
        normalizedVlanId = vlanId
        confirmationAccepted = 'true'
        preparationToken = json.dumps({'Organization': organizationName, 'PolicyName': policyName, 'VlanId': vlanId, 'ConfirmRemoval': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
        preparationStatus = 'ready'
        preparationStatusCode = '200'
        preparationMessage = 'Organization, policy, VLAN ID, VLAN 1 protection, confirmation, and OData fields are valid.'
        preparationResultJson = json.dumps({'validated': True, 'VlanId': vlanId, 'ConfirmRemoval': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    preparationStatus = 'helper-failure'
    preparationStatusCode = '500'
    preparationMessage = 'VLAN removal input preparation failed: ' + str(exc)
    preparationResultJson = json.dumps({'error': 'VLAN removal input preparation failed', 'details': preparationMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
    preparationToken = ''

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
expectedVlanId = int(sys.argv[1])
policyMoid = sys.argv[10]
organizationName = sys.argv[3]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[8]
policyName = sys.argv[5]
confirmation = sys.argv[11]
resolutionStatus = 'invalid'
vlanMoid = ''
vlanName = ''
safetySummaryJson = ''
failureStatusCode = '502'
failureStatusMessage = 'VLAN response was invalid'
failureErrorMessage = 'The VLAN response could not be validated.'
failureResultJson = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))
MOID = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')

def policy_rel(v):
    if not isinstance(v, dict) or str(v.get('Moid', '')).strip() != policyMoid or str(v.get('ObjectType', '')).strip() != 'fabric.EthNetworkPolicy':
        raise ValueError('The VLAN EthNetworkPolicy relationship does not match.')
    c = str(v.get('ClassId', '')).strip()
    if c and c not in ('mo.MoRef', 'fabric.EthNetworkPolicy'):
        raise ValueError('The VLAN EthNetworkPolicy ClassId does not match.')
try:
    if not 2 <= expectedVlanId <= 4093:
        raise ValueError('The expected VLAN ID is outside the independently protected range 2-4093.')
    if not MOID.fullmatch(policyMoid) or not MOID.fullmatch(organizationMoid):
        raise ValueError('The resolved policy or organization Moid is unusable.')
    if confirmation not in ('true', '1'):
        raise ValueError('Validated Confirm Removal is not true.')
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[7])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict) or not isinstance(envelope.get('Results'), list):
        raise ValueError('The response must contain a Results array.')
    values = envelope['Results']
    if len(values) == 0:
        resolutionStatus = 'missing'
        failureStatusCode = '404'
        failureStatusMessage = 'VLAN was not found'
        failureErrorMessage = 'The exact VLAN ID lookup returned zero matches in the resolved policy; no DELETE was sent.'
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'matchCount': 0, 'VlanId': expectedVlanId, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid}, separators=(',', ':'))
    elif len(values) != 1:
        resolutionStatus = 'cardinality'
        failureStatusCode = '409'
        failureStatusMessage = 'VLAN lookup was ambiguous'
        failureErrorMessage = 'The exact VLAN ID lookup returned ' + str(len(values)) + ' matches; exactly one is required.'
        failureResultJson = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'matchCount': len(values), 'VlanId': expectedVlanId, 'PolicyMoid': policyMoid}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        item = values[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError('The single VLAN result is not an object.')
        vlanMoid = str(item.get('Moid', '')).strip()
        rawName = item.get('Name')
        if not MOID.fullmatch(vlanMoid):
            raise ValueError('The VLAN Moid is missing or not URL-safe.')
        if not isinstance(rawName, str) or not rawName.strip() or any((ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in rawName)):
            raise ValueError('The VLAN Name is missing or unsafe to surface.')
        vlanName = rawName
        rawId = item.get('VlanId')
        if not isinstance(rawId, int) or isinstance(rawId, bool) or rawId != expectedVlanId:
            raise ValueError('The returned VlanId does not exactly match.')
        if item.get('ClassId') != 'fabric.Vlan' or item.get('ObjectType') != 'fabric.Vlan':
            raise ValueError('The returned VLAN discriminators do not match.')
        policy_rel(item.get('EthNetworkPolicy'))
        safety = {'Action': 'Delete', 'ConfirmationAccepted': True, 'Organization': {'Moid': organizationMoid, 'Name': organizationName, 'ObjectType': 'organization.Organization'}, 'Policy': {'Moid': policyMoid, 'Name': policyName, 'ObjectType': 'fabric.EthNetworkPolicy'}, 'Vlan': {'Moid': vlanMoid, 'Name': vlanName, 'VlanId': expectedVlanId, 'ObjectType': 'fabric.Vlan'}}
        safetySummaryJson = json.dumps(safety, separators=(',', ':'))
        resolutionStatus = 'exact'
        failureStatusCode = ''
        failureStatusMessage = ''
        failureErrorMessage = ''
        failureResultJson = '{}'
except Exception as exc:
    resolutionStatus = 'invalid'
    vlanMoid = ''
    vlanName = ''
    safetySummaryJson = ''
    failureStatusCode = '502'
    failureStatusMessage = 'VLAN response was invalid'
    failureErrorMessage = 'The VLAN response failed full identity and policy-relationship validation: ' + str(exc)
    failureResultJson = json.dumps({'error': failureStatusMessage, 'details': failureErrorMessage}, separators=(',', ':'))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
safetyStatus = 'invalid'
safetyError = 'The pre-delete VLAN safety summary could not be validated.'
validatedSafetySummaryJson = ''
validatedVlanMoid = ''
MOID = re.compile('^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$')
try:
    summary = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    confirm = sys.argv[12] in ('true', '1')
    organizationName = sys.argv[3]
    policyName = sys.argv[4]
    vlanId = int(sys.argv[5])
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[11]
    policyMoid = sys.argv[13]
    vlanMoid = sys.argv[14]
    vlanName = sys.argv[9]
    token = json.loads(sys.argv[10])
    if not confirm or token != {'Organization': organizationName, 'PolicyName': policyName, 'VlanId': vlanId, 'ConfirmRemoval': True}:
        raise ValueError('Confirmation or preparation token is inconsistent.')
    if not isinstance(summary, dict) or set(summary) != {'Action', 'ConfirmationAccepted', 'Organization', 'Policy', 'Vlan'}:
        raise ValueError('Safety summary fields are incomplete.')
    if summary.get('Action') != 'Delete' or summary.get('ConfirmationAccepted') is not True:
        raise ValueError('Safety summary does not prove confirmed Delete.')
    if not 2 <= vlanId <= 4093:
        raise ValueError('VLAN ID 1 or an out-of-range ID reached the deletion gate.')
    expectedOrg = {'Moid': organizationMoid, 'Name': organizationName, 'ObjectType': 'organization.Organization'}
    expectedPolicy = {'Moid': policyMoid, 'Name': policyName, 'ObjectType': 'fabric.EthNetworkPolicy'}
    expectedVlan = {'Moid': vlanMoid, 'Name': vlanName, 'VlanId': vlanId, 'ObjectType': 'fabric.Vlan'}
    if summary.get('Organization') != expectedOrg or summary.get('Policy') != expectedPolicy or summary.get('Vlan') != expectedVlan:
        raise ValueError('Safety summary identity does not match the exact resolved organization, policy, and VLAN.')
    if not MOID.fullmatch(organizationMoid) or not MOID.fullmatch(policyMoid) or (not MOID.fullmatch(vlanMoid)):
        raise ValueError('A safety-summary Moid is unusable.')
    if not vlanName or any((ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in vlanName)):
        raise ValueError('The safety-summary VLAN Name is missing or unsafe.')
    validatedSafetySummaryJson = json.dumps(summary, separators=(',', ':'))
    validatedVlanMoid = vlanMoid
    safetyStatus = 'ready'
    safetyError = ''
except Exception as exc:
    safetyStatus = 'invalid'
    safetyError = 'Independent pre-delete safety validation failed: ' + str(exc)
    validatedSafetySummaryJson = json.dumps({'error': 'Pre-delete VLAN safety validation failed', 'details': safetyError}, separators=(',', ':'))
    validatedVlanMoid = ''

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
deleteOutcome = 'invalid'
outcomeStatusCode = '500'
outcomeStatusMessage = 'DELETE response evaluation failed'
outcomeErrorMessage = 'The guarded HTTP 200 response could not be validated.'
outcomeResultJson = json.dumps({'error': outcomeStatusMessage, 'deleteMayHaveBeenAccepted': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
try:
    succeededText = sys.argv[5]
    statusText = sys.argv[6]
    responseBody = str(sys.argv[3])
    safety = json.loads(sys.argv[4])
    if not isinstance(safety, dict) or safety.get('Action') != 'Delete' or safety.get('ConfirmationAccepted') is not True or (not isinstance(safety.get('Vlan'), dict)):
        raise ValueError('The validated safety summary is unavailable.')
    if succeededText not in ('true', '1') or statusText != '200':
        raise ValueError('The immediate HTTP guard did not prove activity success with HTTP 200.')
    if sys.argv[7] not in ('', 'null', '""'):
        deleteOutcome = 'success-inconsistent'
        outcomeStatusCode = '502'
        outcomeStatusMessage = 'VLAN DELETE success response was inconsistent'
        outcomeErrorMessage = 'HTTP 200 indicates deletion, but the OpenAPI documents no response content and a body was returned. Do not retry; verify absence.'
        outcomeResultJson = json.dumps({'error': outcomeStatusMessage, 'httpStatus': 200, 'deleteLikelyCompleted': True, 'unexpectedResponseBodyPresent': True, 'unexpectedResponseLength': len(responseBody), 'SafetySummary': safety}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        deleteOutcome = 'deleted'
        outcomeStatusCode = '200'
        outcomeStatusMessage = 'VLAN deleted'
        outcomeErrorMessage = ''
        outcomeResultJson = json.dumps({'deleted': True, 'documentedSuccessStatus': 200, 'responseBodyPresent': False, 'SafetySummary': safety}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    deleteOutcome = 'invalid'
    outcomeStatusCode = '500'
    outcomeStatusMessage = 'DELETE response evaluation failed'
    outcomeErrorMessage = 'The guarded DELETE response helper failed: ' + str(exc)
    outcomeResultJson = json.dumps({'error': outcomeStatusMessage, 'details': outcomeErrorMessage, 'deleteMayHaveBeenAccepted': True}, separators=(',', ':'))
